question: Under what optimized conditions (catalyst amount, methanol/oil ratio, temperature, time) was the maximum biodiesel yield obtained?
question_long: Under what optimized transesterification conditions (catalyst amount, methanol/oil ratio, temperature, time) was the maximum biodiesel yield obtained?
rendered: The maximum biodiesel yield of 98.74% was obtained under the optimized conditions of 30 mg catalyst, a 12 : 1 methanol-to-oil ratio, 65 °C, and 210 min.
